title: The Flooded Library

breakdown.title: The Flooded Library
breakdown.logline: A quiet library floods as books lift off like birds, while the dreamer and their sister row through in a yellow boat as a whale passes by and the city outside is underwater.

words: i had this dream, i was in the old city library. the big reading room with all the green lamps. it was so quiet. then water started coming under the doors.
yeah, it just kept rising. over the desks. then the books started floating off the shelves, open like birds.
drifting mostly. but they looked like wings opening. hundreds of them.
it was kinda dark, but clear. i could see the floor through it. very calm.
my older sister showed up. in this little yellow rowing boat. she told me to get in.
completely calm. like it was normal. i climbed in and she rowed us between the shelves.
still the green lamps mostly. but everything felt softer with the water. then when she opened the high round window, it was bright morning outside.
not really heading somewhere. just rowing. then a whale swam past us under the water. so big it filled the whole aisle.
no. it didn’t scare me at all. it was just slow, moving past.
yeah. exactly. then we went up to that high round window at the top. my sister opened it and outside the whole city was underwater. just rooftops and the tops of trees.
just how things were. peaceful even. then i woke up.
kind of calm still. a bit sad it was over, but mostly quiet.
when the books were lifting off the shelves, before the boat. that second when they opened like birds.
it felt like the room was finally breathing. like the books were awake.
yeah, that’s pretty much it. nothing missing.
yeah, i’d like that.
the one with the books lifting off the shelves, before the boat. that moment.
that fits. the room and the lamps, the dark clear water, the books just lifting and opening. yeah.
leave it just the room. i was just watching.
okay. i’ll look.
small, wooden, bright yellow. like a little rowboat you’d see on a lake.
okay.
a little worn. like it had been used. not new.
good.
okay. take your time.
it looks right. the room and the lamps and the books opening. yeah.
i don’t remember. go with your guess.
i can’t see it yet, but from what you’re saying it sounds right. water starting under the doors, before the room went under.
cool. i’ll keep an eye on them.
yeah, that sounds right. the room still quiet, water up above the blackboards probably. just rising.
right after the books were all off the shelves. she was just there, in the boat. i don’t remember seeing her arrive.
okay. that’s how it was.
all good. i’m just checking them as they come.
yeah, that sounds right. me getting in, her just waiting with the oars. the water was calm.
okay. i’m watching for the rest.
yes, that sounds right. just her rowing, the shelves all around, the water too.
ok. i’m still here.
yeah, that fits. the whale under the water, not scary. just big and slow.
awesome. i’ll check the last one.
yes. the window and the bright morning. that’s how it was. the city outside, underwater.
